passages.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
This happened in the tenth year of Zedekiah.
Zedekiah was king of Judah.
This was also the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylon.
passages.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בִּשְׁנַת הָעֲשִׂרִ֔ית לְצִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֧יא הַשָּׁנָ֛ה שְׁמֹנֶֽה־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּֽר׃

passages.text: At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard, which was in the palace of the king of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The army of the king of Babylon surrounded Jerusalem.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
People imprisoned Jeremiah.
They kept him in the courtyard of the guard.
This courtyard was inside the palace of the king of Judah.
passages.original: וְאָ֗ז חֵ֚יל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְיִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא הָיָ֤ה כָלוּא֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּֽית־ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying: “Why are you prophesying like this? You claim that the LORD says, ‘Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
passages.sermon:
Zedekiah was the king of Judah.
Zedekiah imprisoned Jeremiah.
Zedekiah asked Jeremiah a question.
He said, “Why are you prophesying like this?”
Zedekiah said Jeremiah claimed to speak for the LORD.
Jeremiah said, “The LORD says, ‘I am about to give this city to the king of Babylon.’”
Jeremiah said, “The king of Babylon will capture this city.”
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כְּלָא֔וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ אַתָּ֨ה נִבָּ֜א לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֜ן אֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans, but he will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
passages.sermon:
Zedekiah was the king of Judah.
The Chaldeans were attacking Jerusalem.
Zedekiah will not escape from the Chaldeans.
The king of Babylon will capture Zedekiah.
Zedekiah will be handed over to the king of Babylon.
Zedekiah will speak with the king of Babylon face to face.
Zedekiah will see the king of Babylon with his own eyes.
passages.original: וְצִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵ֖ט מִיַּ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י הִנָּתֹ֤ן יִנָּתֵן֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְדִבֶּר־ פִּ֣יו עִם־ פִּ֔יו וְעֵינָ֖יו אֶת־ עֵינוֹ תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃

passages.text: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will stay until I attend to him, declares the LORD. If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke about Zedekiah, king of Judah.
The LORD said the king of Babylon will take Zedekiah to Babylon.
Zedekiah will remain in Babylon until the LORD attends to him.
The LORD declares this.
If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed.
passages.original: וּבָבֶ֞ל יוֹלִ֤ךְ אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וְשָׁ֣ם יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַד־ פָּקְדִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֧י תִֽלָּחֲמ֛וּ אֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ׃פ

passages.text: Jeremiah replied, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying: Behold! Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, is coming to you to say, ‘Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it.’
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said, “Hanamel will come to you.
Hanamel is the son of your uncle Shallum.
Hanamel will say to you, ‘Buy my field in Anathoth.’
You have the right of redemption to buy this field.
You may buy it for yourself.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ הָיָ֥ה דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ הִנֵּ֣ה חֲנַמְאֵ֗ל בֶּן־ שַׁלֻּם֙ דֹּֽדְךָ֔ בָּ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר קְנֵ֣ה לְךָ֗ אֶת־ שָׂדִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת כִּ֥י לְךָ֛ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה לִקְנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then, as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and urged me, ‘Please buy my field in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin, for you own the right of inheritance and redemption. Buy it for yourself.’ ” Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Hanamel was Jeremiah’s cousin.
The LORD had spoken to Jeremiah before this event.
Hanamel came to Jeremiah in the courtyard of the guard.
Hanamel spoke to Jeremiah.
Hanamel said, “Please buy my field in Anathoth.”
Anathoth is in the land of Benjamin.
Hanamel said, “You have the right of inheritance.”
Hanamel said, “You have the right of redemption.”
Hanamel said, “Buy the field for yourself.”
Jeremiah realized this was the word of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לַי חֲנַמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן־ דֹּדִ֜י כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ חֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י קְנֵ֣ה נָ֠א אֶת־ שָׂדִ֨י אֲשֶׁר־ בַּעֲנָת֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ין כִּֽי־ לְךָ֞ מִשְׁפַּ֧ט הַיְרֻשָּׁ֛ה וּלְךָ֥ הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה קְנֵה־ לָ֑ךְ וָאֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: So I bought the field in Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel, and I weighed out seventeen shekels of silver.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Hanamel was Jeremiah’s cousin.
Hanamel owned a field in Anathoth.
I bought the field in Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel.
I weighed out seventeen shekels of silver for the field.
passages.original: וָֽאֶקְנֶה֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵאֵ֛ת חֲנַמְאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ דֹּדִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֑וֹת וָֽאֶשְׁקֲלָה־ לּוֹ֙ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים וַעֲשָׂרָ֥ה הַכָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: I signed and sealed the deed, called in witnesses, and weighed out the silver on the scales.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
Jeremiah bought a field from his cousin Hanamel.
Jeremiah wrote the purchase agreement in a scroll.
Jeremiah signed the scroll.
Jeremiah sealed the scroll.
Jeremiah called witnesses to see the agreement.
Jeremiah weighed the silver on the scales.
passages.original: וָאֶכְתֹּ֤ב בַּסֵּ֙פֶר֙ וָֽאֶחְתֹּ֔ם וָאָעֵ֖ד עֵדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁקֹ֥ל הַכֶּ֖סֶף בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Then I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy with its terms and conditions, as well as the open copy— and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the sight of my cousin Hanamel and the witnesses who were signing the purchase agreement and all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
passages.sermon:
I took the deed of purchase.
This deed included the sealed copy with its terms and conditions.
This deed also included the open copy.
I gave the deed of purchase to Baruch.
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Neriah was the son of Mahseiah.
I gave the deed in front of my cousin Hanamel.
I gave the deed in front of the witnesses.
These witnesses were signing the purchase agreement.
I gave the deed in front of all the Jews.
These Jews were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
passages.original: וָאֶקַּ֖ח אֶת־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה אֶת־ הֶֽחָת֛וּם הַמִּצְוָ֥ה וְהַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַגָּלֽוּי׃ וָאֶתֵּ֞ן אֶת־ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֗ה אֶל־ בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־ מַחְסֵיָה֒ לְעֵינֵי֙ חֲנַמְאֵ֣ל דֹּדִ֔י וּלְעֵינֵי֙ הָֽעֵדִ֔ים הַכֹּתְבִ֖ים בְּסֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה לְעֵינֵי֙ כָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃

passages.text: In their sight I instructed Baruch, “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take these deeds—both the sealed copy and the open copy of the deed of purchase—and put them in a clay jar to preserve them for a long time.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet in Israel.
Baruch was Jeremiah’s scribe.
Many Jews were present in the courtyard of the guard.
I spoke to Baruch while they watched.
I gave Baruch a command.
I said, “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says.
Take these documents.
Take the deed of purchase.
Take the sealed copy.
Take the open copy.
Put them in a clay jar.
Keep them there for a long time.
This will preserve them.”
passages.original: וָֽאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת בָּר֔וּךְ לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָק֣וֹחַ אֶת־ הַסְּפָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה אֵ֣ת סֵפֶר֩ הַמִּקְנָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת הֶחָת֗וּם וְאֵ֨ת סֵ֤פֶר הַגָּלוּי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וּנְתַתָּ֖ם בִּכְלִי־ חָ֑רֶשׂ לְמַ֥עַן יַעַמְד֖וּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He says, “People will buy houses in this land again.
People will buy fields in this land again.
People will buy vineyards in this land again.”
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֣וֹד יִקָּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֛ים וְשָׂד֥וֹת וּכְרָמִ֖ים בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃פ

passages.text: After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD: “Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of God.
Baruch son of Neriah was Jeremiah’s scribe.
Jeremiah gave the deed of purchase to Baruch.
After this, Jeremiah prayed to the LORD.
Jeremiah said, “O Lord GOD!
You made the heavens.
You made the earth.
You used Your great power.
You used Your outstretched arm.
Nothing is too difficult for You.”
passages.original: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֤י תִתִּי֙ אֶת־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֔ה אֶל־ בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֲהָהּ֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֣ה׀ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֗יתָ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּכֹֽחֲךָ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה לֹֽא־ יִפָּלֵ֥א מִמְּךָ֖ כָּל־ דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them, O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts, the One great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are on all the ways of the sons of men, to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He is great and mighty.
His name is the LORD of Hosts.
He shows loving devotion to thousands.
He repays the iniquity of fathers into the laps of their children after them.
He is great in counsel.
He is mighty in deed.
His eyes watch all the ways of people.
He gives to each person according to his ways.
He rewards each one according to the fruit of his deeds.
passages.original: עֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמְשַׁלֵּם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֔וֹת אֶל־ חֵ֥יק בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַגִּבּ֔וֹר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ גְּדֹל֙ הָֽעֵצָ֔ה וְרַ֖ב הָעֲלִֽילִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ עֵינֶ֣יךָ פְקֻח֗וֹת עַל־ כָּל־ דַּרְכֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְכִפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: You performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and You do so to this very day, both in Israel and among all mankind. And You have made a name for Yourself, as is the case to this day.
passages.sermon:
God performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt.
God still performs signs and wonders today.
God does these things in Israel.
God does these things among all people.
God has made a name for Himself by these acts.
God’s name is still known today because of what He has done.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֠מְתָּ אֹת֨וֹת וּמֹפְתִ֤ים בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבָֽאָדָ֑ם וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.
passages.sermon:
God is great and mighty.
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God brought His people Israel out of Egypt.
God used signs and wonders.
God used a strong hand.
God used an outstretched arm.
God brought them out with great terror.
passages.original: וַתֹּצֵ֛א אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֥ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּאֹת֣וֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֗ים וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבְאֶזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָ֖א גָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: You gave them this land that You had sworn to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
passages.sermon:
God gave the people of Israel a land.
God had promised this land to their ancestors.
God kept His promise.
This land was rich and fruitful.
This land flowed with milk and honey.
passages.original: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

passages.text: They came in and possessed it, but they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your law. They failed to perform all that You commanded them to do, and so You have brought upon them all this disaster.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel entered the land.
They took possession of the land.
They did not listen to Your voice.
They did not follow Your law.
They did not do everything You commanded them to do.
You brought all this disaster upon them.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֗הּ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֤וּ בְקוֹלֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְתֹרוֹתֶךָ לֹא־ הָלָ֔כוּ אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֧יתָה לָהֶ֛ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לֹ֣א עָשׂ֑וּ וַתַּקְרֵ֣א אֹתָ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: See how the siege ramps are mounted against the city to capture it. And by sword and famine and plague, the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it. What You have spoken has happened, as You now see!
passages.sermon:
The Chaldeans are attacking the city.
They have built siege ramps against it.
They want to capture the city.
The city has been handed over to the Chaldeans.
The Chaldeans are fighting against the city.
This happened because of the sword, famine, and plague.
Everything You said has come true.
Now You see it with Your own eyes.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֣ה הַסֹּלְל֗וֹת בָּ֣אוּ הָעִיר֮ לְלָכְדָהּ֒ וְהָעִ֣יר נִתְּנָ֗ה בְּיַ֤ד הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יהָ מִפְּנֵ֛י הַחֶ֥רֶב וְהָרָעָ֖ב וְהַדָּ֑בֶר וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתָּ הָיָ֖ה וְהִנְּךָ֥ רֹאֶֽה׃

passages.text: Yet You, O Lord GOD, have said to me, ‘Buy for yourself the field with silver and call in witnesses, even though the city has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans!’ ”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to me.
He told me to buy a field for myself.
He said to use silver to buy the field.
He told me to call in witnesses for the purchase.
At this time, the city had been given into the hands of the Chaldeans.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ אֵלַי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה קְנֵֽה־ לְךָ֧ הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִ֑ים וְהָעִ֥יר נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for Me?
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said these words.
I am the LORD.
I am the God of all flesh.
Nothing is too difficult for Me.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃ הִנֵּה֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר הֲ‍ֽמִמֶּ֔נִּי יִפָּלֵ֖א כָּל־ דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel and Judah.
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD says this message.
The LORD will give this city to the Chaldeans.
The Chaldeans are a foreign people.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
The LORD will give the city to Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar will capture the city.
The city will fall into their hands.
passages.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ אֶת־ הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את בְּיַ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וּבְיַ֛ד נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come in, set it on fire, and burn it, along with the houses of those who provoked Me to anger by burning incense to Baal on their rooftops and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.
passages.sermon:
The Chaldeans are fighting against this city.
The Chaldeans will enter this city.
The Chaldeans will set this city on fire.
The Chaldeans will burn this city.
The Chaldeans will also burn the houses in this city.
People burned incense to Baal on the rooftops of these houses.
People poured out drink offerings to other gods on these rooftops.
These actions made Me angry.
passages.original: וּבָ֣אוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הַנִּלְחָמִים֙ עַל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְהִצִּ֜יתוּ אֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את בָּאֵ֖שׁ וּשְׂרָפ֑וּהָ וְאֵ֣ת הַבָּתִּ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ קִטְּר֨וּ עַל־ גַּגּֽוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לַבַּ֗עַל וְהִסִּ֤כוּ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: For the children of Israel and of Judah have done nothing but evil in My sight from their youth; indeed, they have done nothing but provoke Me to anger by the work of their hands, declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The children of Israel and the children of Judah are the subject.
They have done evil in the sight of the LORD.
They have done this since their youth.
They have always provoked the LORD to anger.
They have done this by the work of their hands.
The LORD declares this.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הָי֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אַ֣ךְ עֹשִׂ֥ים הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י מִנְּעֻרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַ֣ךְ מַכְעִסִ֥ים אֹתִ֛י בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: For this city has aroused My wrath and fury from the day it was built until now. Therefore I will remove it from My presence because of all the evil the children of Israel and of Judah have done to provoke Me to anger—they, their kings, their officials, their priests and prophets, the men of Judah, and the residents of Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Jerusalem.
God says this city has made Him angry.
God says His anger and fury have burned against this city.
This anger began on the day the city was built.
This anger continues until now.
God will remove this city from His presence.
God will do this because of all the evil done by the people of Israel and Judah.
These people have provoked God to anger.
Their kings have done evil.
Their officials have done evil.
Their priests have done evil.
Their prophets have done evil.
Every man of Judah has done evil.
All the people living in Jerusalem have done evil.
passages.original: כִּ֧י עַל־ אַפִּ֣י וְעַל־ חֲמָתִ֗י הָ֤יְתָה לִּי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לְמִן־ הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לַהֲסִירָ֖הּ מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃ עַל֩ כָּל־ רָעַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְהַכְעִסֵ֔נִי הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִֽיאֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel and Judah have rejected God.
They turned their backs to God.
They did not turn their faces to Him.
God taught them many times.
He taught them again and again.
They did not listen to God.
They refused to accept discipline.
passages.original: וַיִּפְנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛י עֹ֖רֶף וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וְלַמֵּ֤ד אֹתָם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְלַמֵּ֔ד וְאֵינָ֥ם שֹׁמְעִ֖ים לָקַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃

passages.text: They have placed their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel and Judah acted with great evil.
They placed their abominations in the temple.
The temple bears My Name.
They defiled the temple by doing this.
passages.original: וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָֽא־ שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They have built the high places of Baal in the Valley of Hinnom to make their sons and daughters pass through the fire to Molech—something I never commanded them, nor had it ever entered My mind, that they should commit such an abomination and cause Judah to sin.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah built high places for Baal.
They built these places in the Valley of Hinnom.
They made their sons pass through the fire to Molech.
They made their daughters pass through the fire to Molech.
I am the LORD, the God of Israel.
I never commanded them to do this.
I never thought of such a thing.
They did this terrible thing.
They caused Judah to sin.
passages.original: וַיִּבְנוּ֩ אֶת־ בָּמ֨וֹת הַבַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֗ם לְ֠הַעֲבִיר אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם֮ לַמֹּלֶךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְלֹ֤א עָֽלְתָה֙ עַל־ לִבִּ֔י לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַתּוֹעֵבָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לְמַ֖עַן הַחֲטִי אֶת־ יְהוּדָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Now therefore, about this city of which you say, ‘It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword and famine and plague,’ this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I will surely gather My people from all the lands to which I have banished them in My furious anger and great wrath, and I will return them to this place and make them dwell in safety.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks about this city.
You say this city will be given to the king of Babylon.
You say it will fall by the sword, by famine, and by plague.
The LORD says: I will gather My people.
I scattered them to many lands.
I sent them away in My anger and great wrath.
I will bring them back to this place.
I will make them live here in safety.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לָכֵ֛ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־ הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִתְּנָה֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֥ב וּבַדָּֽבֶר׃ הִנְנִ֤י מְקַבְּצָם֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָׁ֛ם בְּאַפִּ֥י וּבַחֲמָתִ֖י וּבְקֶ֣צֶף גָּד֑וֹל וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהֹשַׁבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃

passages.text: They will be My people, and I will be their God.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Judah.
God says, "These people will belong to Me."
I will be their God.
They will be My people.
I will care for them as their God.
passages.original: וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will always fear Me for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks about His people.
The LORD will give His people one heart.
The LORD will give His people one way.
The LORD will do this so His people will always fear Him.
This fear of the LORD will last all their days.
This will be for the good of His people.
This will also be for the good of their children after them.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֜ם לֵ֤ב אֶחָד֙ וְדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶחָ֔ד לְיִרְאָ֥ה אוֹתִ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים לְט֣וֹב לָהֶ֔ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will make an everlasting covenant with His people.
This covenant will last forever.
The LORD will never stop doing good to them.
The LORD will put His fear in their hearts.
They will not turn away from the LORD.
passages.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ אָשׁוּב֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם לְהֵיטִיבִ֖י אוֹתָ֑ם וְאֶת־ יִרְאָתִי֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י ס֥וּר מֵעָלָֽי׃

passages.text: Yes, I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD promises to do good to His people.
The LORD will rejoice in doing good to them.
The LORD will plant His people in this land.
The LORD will do this faithfully.
The LORD will do this with all His heart.
The LORD will do this with all His soul.
passages.original: וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְהֵטִ֣יב אוֹתָ֑ם וּנְטַעְתִּ֞ים בָּאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת בְּכָל־ לִבִּ֖י וּבְכָל־ נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD says: Just as I have brought all this great disaster on this people, so I will bring on them all the good I have promised them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the one speaking.
The LORD has power and authority.
The LORD brought great disaster on this people.
The LORD did this in the past.
The LORD now makes a promise.
The LORD will bring all the good He has promised to this people.
The LORD will do this just as He brought disaster before.
The LORD will fulfill His word.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֥ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את כֵּ֣ן אָנֹכִ֞י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And fields will be bought in this land about which you are saying, ‘It is a desolation, without man or beast; it has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke about this land.
This land now belongs to the Chaldeans.
You say this land is empty.
You say no people live here.
You say no animals live here.
You see only desolation here.
But people will buy fields in this land.
passages.original: וְנִקְנָ֥ה הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים שְׁמָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ מֵאֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ וּבְהֵמָ֔ה נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

passages.text: Fields will be purchased with silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed, and witnessed in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah—the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev—because I will restore them from captivity, declares the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD promises to restore His people from captivity.
People will buy fields with silver.
They will write deeds for these fields.
They will sign and seal the deeds.
Witnesses will confirm the transactions.
This will happen in the land of Benjamin.
This will happen in the areas around Jerusalem.
This will happen in the cities of Judah.
This will happen in the cities of the hill country.
This will happen in the cities of the foothills.
This will happen in the cities of the Negev.
The LORD declares He will do this.
passages.original: שָׂד֞וֹת בַּכֶּ֣סֶף יִקְנ֗וּ וְכָת֨וֹב בַּסֵּ֥פֶר׀ וְחָתוֹם֮ וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִים֒ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן וּבִסְבִיבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּבְעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וּבְעָרֵ֥י הַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י הַנֶּ֑גֶב כִּֽי־ אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ שְׁבוּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
